gates.detail: A partial or failed job is counted in yield and cannot pass the benchmark row.
gates.name: pipeline_yield

gates.detail: Unmatched truth openings and unmatched predictions are scored as failures.
gates.name: opening_widths
gates.threshold: absolute width error <= 2 cm on >= 85%; misses and phantoms count

gates.detail: Accuracy and repeat spread are reported separately to expose bias versus instability.
gates.name: ceiling_height
gates.threshold: error <= 1.5 cm per room; repeat spread <= 1 cm when supplied

gates.detail: Pass --repeat with a second capture of the same room.
gates.name: repeatability
gates.threshold: per-wall spread <= max(1 cm, 0.5% of wall length)

gates.detail: This gate proves the ablation exists; downstream reports must also interpret its delta.
gates.name: drift_accountability
gates.threshold: correction enabled plus a supplied correction-off ablation

gates.detail: This gate applies only to photo-tier predictions.
gates.name: photo_whole_property_stitch
gates.threshold: correct adjacency, no room overlap, and footprint relative error <= 8%

gates.detail: The official prompt does not give this percentage gate for tier 'lidar'.
gates.name: tier_wall_accuracy

gates.detail: Calibration is scored at every tier; this policy is explicit until a published method is supplied.
gates.name: interval_calibration
gates.threshold: empirical coverage must not trail mean declared confidence by more than 5% (explicit internal policy)

gates.detail: Pass --incumbent with the normalized Polycam or magicplan FloorPlan export.
gates.name: head_to_head
gates.threshold: beat or tie incumbent error on >= 70% shared dimensions
